Jordan (Head of Infra): Thanks for joining the infra segment. Rapid Q&A: APAC rollout, expected perf delta, and autoscale safeguards. I'll try to answer live.
Lina (Director, Prod Ops): Is APAC going to have the same GPU families as NA? teams want to plan quantization/compile steps.
Raj (Capacity PM): Short: not identical. We'll start with A10-class SKUs in APAC then add A100s later this year if demand warrants. Compile profiles will reflect that — expect slightly higher token latency on same model + a different memory envelope.
Mei (SRE): How will this affect latency SLAs for hosted vs dedicated customers?
Jordan (Head of Infra): Hosted: we will surface region-aware latency in Console and default routing stays region-local. Dedicated: customers can opt into regional affinity or cross-region failover. SLA language unchanged; failover can introduce extra latency — we'll document it.
Lina (Director, Prod Ops): Can we get an estimate number? PMs asked for P50/P95 delta numbers to present to customers.
Raj (Capacity PM): Action: publishing a small table in the APAC rollout doc. Rough estimates: P50 +10ms, P95 +25-40ms on parity models vs NA (depends on model size and seq len). I'll attach the caveat that heavy KV cache misses can push that further.
infra-bot: Note: APAC pilot signups open: https://redwood.internal/signup/apac-pilot (link)
Mei (SRE): Autoscale question: when we scale in, can we avoid evicting hot KV shards? we've seen tail latency spikes before.
Jordan (Head of Infra): We're adding a 90s drain window and selective cold-evict policy. Scale decisions will prefer spinning down preemptible nodes first. Not perfect but reduces hot-shard evictions.
Mei (SRE): will the Console alerts include cache hit ratio + worker drain rate for pilot tenants?
Raj (Capacity PM): Yes. Pilot tenants get extended telemetry and a recommended alert bundle. We'll share alert thresholds in the onboarding doc.
Lina (Director, Prod Ops): Any changes to autoscaler backoff/resync? teams reported oscillation in last test.
Jordan (Head of Infra): Tuned: longer cooldown for scale-out/scale-in during bursty patterns, and a hysteresis layer on token-rate metrics. We also added a smoothing window to prevent reacting to single-shot spikes.
Mei (SRE): Good. Can SRE run a chaos canary (node preempt + cache warmup) during pilot?
Jordan (Head of Infra): Yes — we'll schedule with you. Raj, please create INFRA-APAC-PILOT and include canary runbook.
Raj (Capacity PM): Done. INFRA-APAC-PILOT created and assigned.
Lina (Director, Prod Ops): Thanks everyone. If product teams need wording for customer comms, ping me and I'll draft a short FAQ.
Jordan (Head of Infra): Closing: we'll update the APAC doc with numbers + routing samples by EOD Friday. DM me for exceptions. :raised_hands:
